tech.minestuckuniverseported.celestial_s: Manipulates Time itself to advance or rewind the current time of day. It will not be noticeable in dimensions without a day-night cycle like The Medium.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.chronofreez: Uses the aspect of Time to conjure Time Stop for a short period of time upon a target, completely freezing them in place.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.flow_accele: Speeds up whatever block you're looking at for as long as you hold down this Abilitech.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.rapid_rewin: Regresses the targeted creature or object in time whilst held, mimicking the effects of the Time Tables.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.accelerando: Pushes Time forwards for the targeted entity, speeding them up for as long as this Abilitech is active. Tethers to target.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.temporal_re: Lets you travel through Time itself, restoring your health and position to how they were 5 seconds in the past.
Speeds up your own actions - movement and mining/attack speed - for as long as this Abilitech is held.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.slow.toolti: Slows down whatever you're looking at - movement and mining/attack speed - for as long as this Abilitech is held.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.time_dilati: Hold and aim at a target to afflict them with Time Dilation, drastically slowing their movement (and attack speed) and warping their own vision, while speeding yourself up in turn - their time, taken and given to you. Every few seconds their position locks up, they take a burst of damage, and they can't act - a real lag spike.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.parallel_ac: Summons a temporal double of yourself, armed with a randomly-picked weapon from your strife decks, that guards the spot it appeared at and fights off nearby hostiles for a short while. Press again to dismiss it early.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.timeline_re: Hold to charge, release to actually undo the last few seconds of the world - not just yourself. Rewinding always costs Timeline Debt.
Nothing recorded to rewind to yet
tech.minestuckuniverseported.retrocognit: Reveals nearby blocks and creatures as they were up to a few minutes ago, playing forward around you as you move - without changing anything about the present, and without pulling you out of your own body.
The past comes into focus - reliving the last %s seconds around you
tech.minestuckuniverseported.timeline_br: Tap to fork a new parallel timeline branch from right here and jump into it. Hold ~1 second and release to return to this branch's parent. Hold ~3 seconds and release to jump straight back to the Alpha Timeline.
Failed to fork a new timeline branch
That branch has %s child branch(es) - add 'confirm' to delete it and all of them
You return to the parent timeline.
You return to the Alpha Timeline.
This is already the Alpha Timeline - there's no parent to return to.
gui.soulStun.title: Your soul has been shocked. You cannot act.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.future_requ: Hold to choose a category (Weapon, Armor, Food, Utility, Resource), release to borrow a progression-appropriate item from your future self. Every borrowed item is a paradox that must eventually be repaid with a freshly-obtained copy at a Temporal Sendificator, or it accrues Doom Points.
status.minestuckuniverseported.timeReque: Borrowed %s from your future self - repay it with a new copy before the paradox catches up with you
You can't borrow from your future self again so soon
No item is configured for that category yet
Timeline stabilized - the borrowed %s has been repaid
tech.minestuckuniverseported.time_loop.t: Hold to charge, release to loop the last few seconds of recorded history in a zone around you, repeating until the charge time runs out. Multiple Timeloops can freely overlap.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.time_loop_n: On death, rewind time by 8 seconds.
Time Loop created - looping the last %s seconds, for %s seconds total
Time Loop nested onto an existing loop - looping the last %s seconds, for %s seconds total
status.minestuckuniverseported.timeLoopN: Timeloop β intervened - the last %s seconds are looping around you
tech.minestuckuniverseported.time_loop_o: Muse of Time exclusive - press to instantly loop the last 8 seconds in a zone around you, for 1 hunger. No charging required.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.years_in_se: Press to apply Time Dilation to every other entity nearby for 10 seconds, at the cost of Weakness II and Slowness V on yourself for the same duration. 1 minute cooldown.
status.minestuckuniverseported.yearsInSe: Years in Seconds is still recovering
tech.minestuckuniverseported.enchanters_: While equipped grants 1.5x experience whenever you gain any, and lets you read the enchanting table's text for what it really says.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.sticky_fing: Press to steal durability, enchantments, and potion effects from the item in your main hand and give them to the item in your off-hand.
status.minestuckuniverseported.stickyFin: You need an item in each hand
tech.minestuckuniverseported.lifeforce_t: Lets you donate some of your health to the targeted entity, making you take damage whilst healing them. If the target is already fully healed, their max health will be increased for a short period of time.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.bleeding_ed: Gives all your melee hits a chance to inflict Bleeding upon the target while active. Chance is determined by your Luck.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.haemodome.t: Use the power of Blood to create a protective dome around you and your allies, shielding you from projectiles, other Abilitechs, as well as preventing anyone from coming in, but not out.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.reformers_r: Utilizing the power of Blood, this Abilitech makes all passive mobs fall to your influence, and hostile mobs much less likely to target you.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.tempesting_: Harnesses the power found within the aspect of Breath to propel you upwards into the air, striking deadly lightning where you used to stand.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.windsweepin: Uses the aspect of Breath to summon intense wind that knocks most entities back.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.entombing_t: Casts a powerful bubble upon the target that slowly sucks out all of the air inside of it. The bubble prevents anyone from coming in or coming out.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.vertigo_blo: Completely negates fall damage while this Abilitech is equipped.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.supersonic_: Taps into the essence of Breath to passively give the user the ability to traverse the ground at breakneck speeds. Can be toggled on/off by using the Abilitech.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.vessel_of_t: Lets you become one with the wind, granting you temporary flight as well as the ability to phase to non-full blocks.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.survivors_b: Prevents any attack from killing you when above low health, leaving you in half a heart as well as granting you invincibility for a very short period of time.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.chains_of_d: Briefly inhibits the ability to fly for all nearby players, including the user. Charging this Abilitech further inhibits the ability to build for all targets.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.withering_w: Brings forth Doom upon all nearby creatures, casting a deadly spell that incrementally withers away at their health.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.terminal_de: Immediately kills the target if their health is low enough, completely bypassing their Conditional Immortality. This abilitech will also affect the user, so watch your health when using it!
tech.minestuckuniverseported.deaths_shro: Immediately kills all nearby living creatures and players if their health is low enough, bringing the caster down with them, completely bypassing Conditional Immortality. Only use as a last resort!
Creates an ensnaring bubble around the target, allowing anyone to come in, but preventing them from coming out. The bubble shields anyone inside it from projectiles and other Abilitechs.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.spiritual_b: Synchronizes the user's health bar with the target's for as long as the Abilitech is in use, making both players take damage if one of them does.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.astral_proj: Knocks your Soul out of your body, for as long as the Abilitech is in use, or until your body receives damage.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.soul_switch: Transfers your Soul over to the target's body and vice versa, making you exchange positions, Potion Effects, and health.
Holds the target's soul hostage for as long as the Abilitech is in use and a line of sight is kept, completely disabling their ability to react.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.divine_clea: Channels the user's Hope powers to rid the target or themself from all Potion Effects. Prevents the use of all Abilitechs for a short period of time afterwards.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.willed_alli: Channels all your beliefs as a Hope player into summoning a powerful ally.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.answered_pr: Blesses all nearby players and passive creatures with a random positive Potion Effect.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.return_jump: Utilizes the energy found within Return Medallions to teleport the user back to their home base on command.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.sylladex_sl: Launches the first available item from the player's Sylladex forwards, causing it to deal damage upon whomever it hits.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.draconic_au: Calls forth the unlimited energy found within Dragon Gel to gradually heal the user when held. This energy is unstable, and will release an explosion if the user is hit while using it, leaving them weakened and unable to cast any Abilitechs for a short period of time.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.hopeful_out: Releases an aura of pure, concentrated Hope that constantly damages all that are inside it, as well as slowing down nearby projectiles.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.wormhole_tr: Bend Space itself to teleport yourself forwards a couple of blocks.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.anchored_wo: Crouch while pressing to summon a Teleport Focus Point. Teleports you to your set Anchor Point, or a nearby random position if none is set.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.spatial_war: Crouch while pressing to summon a Teleport Focus Point. Teleports the targeted entity to your set Anchor Point, or a nearby random position if none is set.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.matter_mani: Bends Space itself to collapse a defined area into a single item. The corners of the area are defined by pressing the key while looking at the desired block.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.spatial_man: Shrinks and enlarges certain entities and SBURB Machines, similar in function to Spatial Manipulation Dust.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.kinetic_gra: Allows you to grab hold of any creature or inanimate entity, as long as their soul is light enough, pulling them into the direction you're facing.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.grasp_of_th: Channels the aspect of Void within you, allowing you to pierce your hand through void itself and recover any lost items.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.return_to_d: Channels the aspect of Void within you to send any entity back into the void from which they came from. This Abilitech doesn't affect players.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.voidstep.to: Allows you to passively pass through blocks at the cost of some energy. Can be toggled on/off by using the Abilitech.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.vacuum_siph: Creates negative space right where you're standing, pulling all nearby entities towards you with increasing force the more you hold down this Abilitech.
status.skaianScroll.outOfScrolls: §cThe scroll refuses to lend you its wisdom.
status.skaianScroll.notEligible: §cThe scroll's wisdom of %s is not meant for you.
item.manipulatedMatter.tooBig: Focal Area is too big, should be at most 8x8x8
status.spatialWarp.setPoint: Warp Point set at X: %s Y: %s Z: %s
tech.minestuckuniverseported.illusory_cl: Casts an illusion upon all players, disguising you as the targeted creature until cast again.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.sensory_bre: Scrambles the target's mind for a short period of time, reversing their controls whilst in effect.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.mindflayers: Allows you to take control of any player or living creature's Mind, as long as it has one or isn't fortified enough.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.godhoods_ju: Passively nudges your Static Karma back toward balance over time, pulled in whichever direction your Temp Karma currently leans.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.calculated_: Sifts through all possible futures in order to increase the damage of your next attack. The extra damage done fluctuates, generally raising, the longer it's charged, but lowering over time if it's not used.
status.calculatedStrike.low: Your next attack is calculated, but, boy, are you bad at math...
status.calculatedStrike.med: While uncertain, you at least have a plan.
status.calculatedStrike.high: You know your next attack will strike true!
tech.minestuckuniverseported.enraged_ber: Using your mastery over the aspect of Rage, this Abilitech makes you enter a deadly BERSERK state for a brief period of time.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.vengeful_ou: Channels your inner fury against all nearby living creatures, dealing damage according to how much time you've spent in battle.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.anger_manag: Grants you the ability to control the targeted mob's hostility, both friendly and aggressive. Hold down the button to affect all creatures in an area.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.frenzied_ma: Puts all nearby creatures into a frenzied state, causing them to start attacking one another.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.orb_of_ligh: One of the most basic Abilitechs bound to the aspect of Light. Using it creates a small Glowing Orb that can light up dark areas.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.eternal_glo: Passively generates Glowing Orbs around you whenever the block light level nearby gets too low. Using it lets you generate one on command instead of waiting.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.lightbound_: Tap into the aspect of Light to reveal the location of every player in the area, marking them with Glowing for a handful of seconds. Charge the Abilitech for longer to target all living entities as well.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.storm_of_th: Grants you the ability to mark any targeted entity with Glowing. Charging this abilitech allows you to cast down powerful lightning upon all that are glowing.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.hardlight_b: Bend light itself to create a protective dome around you and your allies, shielding you from projectiles, other Abilitechs, as well as preventing anyone from coming in or out.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.skaian_insi: This Abilitech allows to tap into your mastery over the aspect of Light, granting you the luck and insight needed to find important items such as Jujus and Skaian Scrolls more easily.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.lifeforce_l: Gradually steals some of the target's lifeforce for as long as it's in use, damaging them whilst healing the user. Tethers to target.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.healing_aur: Grants Regeneration to the target and all nearby creatures for a brief period of time.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.mating_seas: Puts all nearby animals into a breeding mood.
Creates a small floating Orb that fertilizes nearby crops.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.song_of_fer: Greatly fertilizes all nearby plants, as well as making all nearby animals breed. Truly a Life player's greatest tool.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.saving_grac: Casts a protective spell upon the target, bringing them once back to life right after they die. This Abilitech can only be used once per player until the user dies.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.bard_disson: Randomly curses or blesses everyone nearby, based on your own Title's aspect.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.magic_metro: Borrows a random ability from anyone equipped and drives it on your behalf for as long as you hold it.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.heir_will.t: Whenever you take damage or die, has a chance to curse whoever caused it with your own Title aspect's affliction.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.universal_r: Whenever your own attack lands while you're badly hurt, has a chance to curse your target instead.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.guardian_ha: Freezes every dropped item, arrow, and other non-living entity nearby in place while held.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.knight_ward: A quick tap wards your target and yourself with Resistance; holding escalates it into an area-wide ward.
Passive - landing a hit forms a red link with that target: you deal bonus damage to them while bonded, and they take chip damage if they stray too far from you.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.lord_decree: After a long charge, curses every distant rival and nearby hostile mob within a huge radius.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.mage_awaren: Reveals your own Karma alignment through a shifting aura of light.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.arcane_stud: Passively catches whichever ability just targeted you, letting you drive it yourself afterward.
A quick tap blesses your target with an ambient boon; holding escalates it into a blessing for everyone nearby.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.irradiant_s: Passively showers every nearby animal and player with your own ambient Title-aspect blessing.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.muse_requie: Should you die, blesses every player of opposing Karma with your own ambient Title-aspect boon.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.perseverant: A rite of passage available only to those who have already ascended to God Tier.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.prince_wrat: Charge and release a wrathful strike against your target, growing stronger the longer it's held.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.ruling_slas: Passively triples your damage against anyone sharing your own Title's aspect.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.rogue_contr: A quick tap copies your own active effects onto your target; holding spreads them to everyone nearby.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.roguelike_a: Borrows an ability straight off another player's own loadout and drives it on your behalf.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.seer_predic: Hold while looking at another player to slowly reveal their Karma alignment.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.foresight_d: Passively lets you see an incoming attack coming and evade it entirely, on a cooldown.
Hold while looking at an injured or hungry ally to slowly mend their wounds.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.karmic_rest: Hold while looking at another player to slowly nudge their Karma back toward balance.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.thief_filch: Charge and release while looking at another player to lock them down and filch their ambient blessing.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.witch_inhib: Charge and release while looking at a target to briefly lock down their God Tier powers.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.wicked_trap: Plants a lingering cloud of your own Title aspect's affliction wherever you're looking.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.cult_of_per: Press while aiming at a living entity to bind it into a Blood Bond cult - press again on another entity to link them together. Bonded members share a portion of each other's damage and retaliate against whoever kills one of them. Press an already-bonded member of your own cult to select it, then press again on a location or another entity to order it to move or attack. Sneak while pressing to start a new, separate cult.
status.minestuckuniverseported.cultOfPer: Marked as the first link of the cult - target another entity to bind them.
Cult chain reset - your next target starts a new cult.
Selected - target a location or another entity to give an order.
The corruption has been cleansed - the bond is restored.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.schism.tool: Press while aiming at a living entity that belongs to an active Blood Bond to corrupt it - shared damage becomes amplified instead of reduced, and surviving members blame each other instead of avenging their fallen. Press an already-corrupted bond again to remove the corruption. Toggle passive mode on for a standing aura around you: nearby uncorrupted Blood Bonds share less effectively, and nearby mobs periodically risk losing their current target.
status.minestuckuniverseported.schismNot: That entity isn't part of any Blood Bond.
status.minestuckuniverseported.schismRel: Its unstable relationships have been corrupted.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.crimson_dis: Press while aiming at a living entity to destabilize every relationship it's currently a party to. Toggle passive mode on for a standing aura around you: nearby relationships slowly grow unstable, weakening Blood Bonds and Blood Vengeance until they eventually collapse on their own - which then destabilizes other nearby relationships in turn. Even unconnected nearby creatures aren't safe: the aura slowly turns random pairs of them against each other, escalating until they actually start fighting. Instability decays naturally over time when nothing is actively raising it.
status.minestuckuniverseported.crimsonDi: That entity has no relationships to destabilize.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.blood_insig: Press while aiming at a living entity to read out every relationship it's currently a party to - who with, what type, and how strong/stable each one is.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.blood_memor: Press while aiming at a living entity to read out the most recent events across all of its relationships - who helped or harmed it, and when.
tech.minestuckuniverseported.blood_guida: Press while aiming at a living entity to reinforce every relationship it's currently a party to - a real strength and stability boost, making them more resistant to being weakened by hostile Blood magic like the Schism Aura. Cannot create a relationship that doesn't already exist.
status.minestuckuniverseported.bloodGuid: That entity has no relationships to reinforce.
badge.minestuckuniverseported.karma.tool: Sacrifice 128 moonstone and 8000 Gold grist to attune yourself more deeply to Karma's pull.
badge.minestuckuniverseported.effect_buf: Sacrifice 5 nearby frogs and 5000 Quartz grist to strengthen your own ambient Title-aspect blessing.
badge.minestuckuniverseported.page_poten: Spend 80 experience levels to unlock your true Page potential.
badge.minestuckuniverseported.world_ende: A secret only the truly ascended can earn - and only in battle.
status.overlordSkillLevel: You must reach skill level %s to ascend as World Ender.
status.overlordPvpDeath: You must fall in battle against another player to ascend as World Ender.
